Crawl with browser mode 'auto' falls back to browser when encountering WAF 403

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"auto\"},\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.crawl_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(length(result.pages))
```
